summary: fractal-web marks browser offline as stale immediately, reconnects on online or explicit action, and probes a subscription on visible resume with a bounded response deadline; the footer uses user-facing connection wording without exposing gateway hosts and the composer notice has a typed app-side seam pending its shared UI slot

replay.detail: Client-only connection handling; no runtime replay change. Healthy idle sockets are not periodically recycled. Visible-resume probes neither bypass reconnect backoff nor interrupt an in-flight attempt.

schema.detail: No database schema change. Connection and domain observations remain memory-only.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing collection subscriptions and authoritative responses; no wire-format change. The composer-docked banner is not rendered until the shared UI supplies its notice slot.

downtime.detail: No service interruption introduced. A missing live-socket probe response closes the socket after 15 seconds and reuses existing backoff; removing or replacing its subscription generation cancels the deadline. Explicit reconnect may make one reachability attempt despite an offline hint, and a successful transport overrides that hint. Repeated actions coalesce until the read and upgrade complete.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; this change does not deploy the app.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change. Last-known roster and conversation content is retained while stale.
